usageNote: 口语短语！'loads of'就是'超多'的意思，比'a lot of'更随意更有活力，朋友聊天专用！

examples.en: I have loads of free time this weekend — let's hang out!
examples.zh: 我这周末超级有空，我们出去玩吧！

examples.en: She had loads of free time after quitting her second job.
examples.zh: 她辞掉兼职后，突然多出好多空闲时间。
